hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes a quote using its own bonding-curve invariant (CurveLib), takes input tokens from the PoolManager into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — replacing standard Uniswap v4 AMM pricing. Liquidity addition and donations are intentionally blocked.
